zh.title: 空中巴士向法國交付首架特種作戰型NH90直升機
zh.summary: 空中巴士於2026年7月30日在馬里尼揚向法國軍備總局交付首架NH90 Standard 2特種作戰直升機，並於當日移交法國陸軍輕航空兵。法國共訂購18架該型直升機，預計於2029年中前完成交付，將派駐於波城的第4特種部隊直升機團，逐步取代現役的Caracal與Cougar直升機。
body: 空中巴士 Helicopters 於2026年7月30日在法國馬里尼揚正式向法國軍備總局（DGA）交付首架 NH90 Standard 2 直升機。法國軍備總局在接收該架機型後，於同一天將其移交給法國陸軍輕航空兵（ALAT），開啟了專為特種作戰配置的 NH90 系列直升機交付序幕。
法國軍方總共訂購了 18 架 NH90 Standard 2 直升機，預計所有機型將在 2029 年年中以前完成交付。這批新直升機將全數部署於位於法國西南部的波城第 4 特種部隊直升機團（4e RHFS），協助特種部隊在複雜環境中執行高難度任務。
與一般部隊操作的 Standard 1 版本相比，Standard 2 規格進行了多項專門針對特種作戰的升級配置。其配備了 Safran Euroflir 410 D 光電系統與全新的數位地圖生成器，並增設第三名機組人員的位置。此外，機身後側滑門窗戶經過擴大，可安裝防護機槍，同時配備由法國軍事航空服務機構 SIAé 開發的特種部隊無線電套件，並恢復了突擊隊的快速繩降能力。
這 18 架 NH90 Standard 2 直升機投入服役後，將逐步取代法國陸軍現役的 Caracal 與 Cougar 直升機，從而釋放現有的 H225M Caracal 直升機並移交給法國空天軍營運。北大西洋公約組織直升機管理局（NAHEMA）代表法國於 2020 年下達該升級標準的開發訂單。
除了法國之外，西班牙也於 2025 年 12 月加入該升級計畫，訂購了 31 架相同標準配置的 NH90 直升機。這顯示 NH90 Standard 2 規格正在逐步成為全球特種部隊直升機的新基準。

en.title: Airbus Delivers First Special Operations NH90 Standard 2 Helicopter to France
en.summary: Airbus Helicopters officially delivered the first NH90 Standard 2 helicopter to the French Armament General Directorate (DGA) at Marignane on July 30, 2026, which was subsequently passed to French Army Light Aviation. Designed specifically for special operations, this is the first of 18 helicopters ordered by France to be delivered by mid-2029. The fleet will be operated by the 4th Special Forces Helicopter Regiment at Pau, featuring upgraded systems including the Safran Euroflir 410 D electro-optical system, and will progressively replace the French Army's existing Caracal and Cougar helicopters.
body: Airbus Helicopters officially delivered the first NH90 Standard 2 military helicopter to the French Armament General Directorate (DGA) at Marignane on July 30, 2026. The DGA transferred the specialized rotorcraft to French Army Light Aviation (ALAT) on the same day, launching the operational deployment of this new special forces variant for the French armed forces.

The delivered aircraft represents the first of 18 NH90 Standard 2 helicopters ordered by France, with complete delivery expected by mid-2029. The entire fleet will be stationed at Pau in southwestern France, assigned to the 4th Special Forces Helicopter Regiment (4e RHFS) to execute demanding operations in difficult conditions.

The Standard 2 configuration incorporates tailored upgrades designed specifically for special operations missions. Features include the Safran Euroflir 410 D electro-optical system with laser designation capabilities, a new digital map generator, provision for a third crew member, enlarged rear sliding windows accommodating gun mounts, and special forces radio kits developed by SIAé for joint and coalition operations.

The progressive delivery of these 18 NH90 Standard 2 aircraft will enable the French Army to replace its active fleet of Caracal and Cougar helicopters. This operational reorganization will subsequently free up H225M Caracals for transfer to the French Air and Space Force’s 1/67 Pyrénées squadron stationed at Cazaux.

Development of the Standard 2 variant was contracted in 2020 by the NATO Helicopter Management Agency (NAHEMA) on behalf of France under military programming laws. In December 2025, Spain joined the program by ordering 31 NH90 helicopters in a similar special operations standard configuration.

zh.title: 中國商飛C919高原型完成首飛 專為高原航線設計
zh.summary: 中國商用飛機公司開發的C919高原型（C919-600）已完成首飛。這款緊湊型客機專為服務高高原機場的航線所設計。根據歷史紀錄，原型機於2026年7月29日自上海浦東國際機場起飛進行試飛，飛行時間為1小時59分鐘，該型號由中國商飛與西藏航空聯合開發。
body: 中國商用飛機公司（COMAC）開發的C919高高原變型機C919-600已順利完成首飛作業。這款新發表的緊湊型窄體客機，專為服務高海拔高原地區機場的營運航線所特別設計。
根據本站紀錄的歷史資料，登記號為B-002U的C919高原原型機於2026年7月29日自上海浦東國際機場起飛，完成歷時1小時59分鐘的試飛。
這項C919高原型客機計畫是由中國商飛與西藏航空共同合作開發，設計載客量介於140名至160名乘客之間。

en.title: High-Altitude COMAC C919-600 Variant Completes Maiden Test Flight
en.summary: The high-altitude variant of the COMAC C919 narrowbody airliner, designated C919-600, has completed its maiden flight. Designed as a compact variant, the aircraft is specifically built for routes serving airports on high plateaus. According to historical archive records, the prototype aircraft registered B-002U departed Shanghai Pudong International Airport on July 29, 2026, and flew for one hour and 59 minutes during its initial test flight. The high-altitude model is being jointly developed by COMAC and Tibet Airlines with a planned seating capacity of 140 to 160 passengers.
body: The high-altitude variant of the Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC) C919, known as the C919-600, has completed its maiden flight. The compact aircraft variant is engineered specifically to operate on routes serving high-plateau airports.

Historical records show that the C919-600 prototype, registered B-002U, conducted its test flight on July 29, 2026. After taking off from Shanghai Pudong International Airport, the aircraft remained airborne for one hour and 59 minutes.
The high-altitude C919 variant is being jointly developed by manufacturer COMAC in partnership with Tibet Airlines, featuring a passenger seating capacity designed for between 140 and 160 passengers.
